title: Native derived compact support commutes with forgetting and free induction
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type over $k_0$, with $Y_0$ quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally of finite type over $k_0$, and $X_0$ quasi-compact and locally of finite type over $k_0$. Fix its native chosen compactification $X_0\xrightarrow{j_0}Z_0\xrightarrow{p_0}Y_0$, where $j_0$ is open and $p_0$ proper. For $T_0=X_0,Y_0,Z_0$ write $T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$, and use the locally finite continuous coefficient sheaf $B_T$, its internal module category $\mathcal A_T$, the geometric Frobenius pullback $P_T$, and the fixed-pair heart $\mathcal W_T=\mathcal A_T^{P_T}$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Thus a constructible sheaf has locally a finite locally closed constructible stratification and, on each stratum, a pro-etale covering with finite free model $B_U^{\oplus r_U}$ on each member $U$; ranks may depend on $U$. Put $\mathcal C_T=D^b_{\mathrm{cons}}(\mathcal A_T)$ and $\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal C_T)$, the full replete triangulated closure under small coproducts in the ordinary derived category. Fix one universe for all Hom groups, generating sets and coproducts [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]. Write $U_T:D(\mathcal W_T)\to D(\mathcal A_T)$ for derived forgetting, $I_T\dashv U_T$ for exact free induction with $U_TI_TA=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}P_T^nA$ [lem-sf-free-derived-weil-resolution], and $\eta_T$ for its unit. Set $F=Rp_*D(j_!)$ and $F_W=Rp_*^{\mathcal W}D(j_!^{\mathcal W})$, the actual native sheaf operations with their specified coefficient maps and Frobenius lifts, on ordinary unbounded derived categories. Neither scheme is required to be separated over $k_0$.

The categories $\mathcal A_T$ and $\mathcal W_T$ are Grothendieck abelian; $U_T$ is exact, conservative, preserves small coproducts and K-injective complexes, and $P_T$ preserves $\mathcal C_T$ and $\mathcal L_T$. The functors $F,F_W$ are triangulated. There is a natural isomorphism on the entire ordinary derived categories
$$\beta:U_YF_W\xrightarrow{\sim}FU_X.$$
For $p_*$ its normalization is identical evaluation on every K-injective Weil complex, using $U_Yp_*^{\mathcal W}=p_*U_Z$ on both objects and morphisms; for $j_!$ it uses the termwise equality $U_Zj_!^{\mathcal W}=j_!U_X$. Let $c_n:P_Y^nF\xrightarrow{\sim}FP_X^n$ be the coherent iterates, for all integers $n$, of the derived native Frobenius exchanges. The transpose of
$$FA\xrightarrow{F\eta_{X,A}}FU_XI_XA\xrightarrow{\beta_{I_XA}^{-1}}U_YF_WI_XA$$
under $I_Y\dashv U_Y$ defines a natural map $\kappa_A:I_YFA\to F_WI_XA$. For every $A\in\mathcal L_X$ it is an isomorphism. More precisely, after applying $U_Y$ and then $\beta_{I_XA}$, its restriction to the summand $P_Y^nFA$ is
$$P_Y^nFA\xrightarrow{c_{n,A}}F(P_X^nA)\xrightarrow{F(\iota_n)}F(\bigoplus_mP_X^mA),$$
where $\iota_n:P_X^nA\to\bigoplus_mP_X^mA$ is the coprojection. These are comparisons of functors on derived morphisms, with no identification of $D(\mathcal W_T)$ with fixed pairs in $D(\mathcal A_T)$.

S1 split with 0 new nodes; the statement and its 4 stmt_deps are unchanged and proof_deps equal the union of the steps' uses. It is not a 2026-10-21 re-split: no repair note applies. I read in full the item, the parent thm-sf-weil-compact-direct-image-right-adjoint (steps 1 and 3 use only beta and I_YF≅F_WI_X on L_X), every cited statement, and the blueprint main-20261015 places cor-coef-verdier-weil-equivariance.proof.md (final sentence) and lem-fix-weil-operations.proof.md (first two paragraphs). No SGA is cited. Steps 1-3: the B_T modules are sheaves of modules, so ring-sheaves-grothendieck applies; P_T is an exact equivalence by Frobenius site reindexing, with the coefficient identification supplied in the step itself. constructible-pullback holds for any morphism, so P_T preserves C_T, and L_T by the localizing preimage argument. fixed-pair-derived-forget (C=D=A_T, F=H=P_T) and free-derived-resolution give the hearts and the adjunction. j_! is the slice j_{A!} (localization (4): at most one summand); p_* is left exact as a right adjoint and its lift by creation of finite limits. Step 4: kinjective-exact-square with H'=p_*^W, H=p_*, r=U_Z, s=U_Y; sH'=Hr holds literally from the framework lift formula, and r preserves K-injectives, so beta is normalized on K-injectives with the identity on the common p_*U_ZJ model; the open factor descends by exact-derived-natural-iso. Step 5: exact-equivalence-squares with E=P_Y, G=P_Z, R=p_* and zero left functors; exact-adjoint-forget shows P preserves K-injectives; c_n is defined for negative n through the inverse. Step 6: tau is legitimate via the termwise lift and phi:P̃⇒id; the chain equation together with kinjective-derived-map-computation gives the structure formula. Step 7: I re-derived beta·U(kappa)·iota_n = F(tau^(n))c_n P^nF(eta) = F(iota_n)c_{n,A} and checked n=0, 1, -1. Step 8: qc+lft gives finite type; the base-change lemmas cover lft, qc, separated finite type, proper and open; Z is finite type by composition with proper p_0. compact-support-sums matches exactly (same B_T and C_T, separated finite-type f, no absolute separatedness, sums only on L_X); P^nA lies in L_X by step 1, and the universal property plus conservativity of U finish. Small cases checked: A=0, p=j=id, P=id with nontrivial theta (negative n), unbounded complexes. Batch-5 flag on lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-sums: accepted. It is the sibling node Q06 created for this parent and unit, and it states a general coproduct preservation for Rp_*j_!. The flagged lem-pd-section-derived-pushpull-normalization is a generic comparison between internal-module and section-module derived pushpull and is already in the parent's closure without this item. The 44 nodes the item newly adds to the closure (trf point systems, free-module sheaves, pod lisse/Galois correspondences, mates) are foundations, not steps of the trace-formula or Poincaré-duality proofs. Accepted generic tool_uses are listed in review.md. Advisory: lem-sf-native-weil-open-proper-forgetting states beta only for separated schemes, so it is an overlap, not a citable duplicate.
